description: This Java class `LibraryThingBookDataImport` is part of a book management project, specifically responsible for importing or representing book data from LibraryThing. It holds a collection of `LibraryThingBookImport` objects mapped by some key and provides a method to retrieve these objects as a list.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookDataImport
classes.description: A class representing imported library books with functionality to convert the stored books map into a list.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Converts the internal map of books into a list of `LibraryThingBookImport` objects.
